reuse.why: Changes the existing getRangedAmount/getApproxAmount helpers behind getExpectedAmount, which every consumer already calls, and keeps using getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: The rule is edited in its single definition; no logic is copied anywhere.

placement.why: The change lives in shared/schedules.ts where the tree already defines the expected-amount rule.

scope.why: Only the two helpers, their comments, the matching tests and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: Math.min and amount - threshold state the new rule directly, but call-site comments in forecast-schedules.ts, schedules/app.ts and shared/schedules.ts still say 'furthest from zero'.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; all paths go through getExpectedAmount
